verdict.rationale: Muse is itself a consumer personal AI agent, which plays the MCP client role, so serving tools to other agents via an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Muse running as an MCP server: there is no 'mcp serve' mode or hosted MCP endpoint, and the probe found no MCP discovery surface. Its custom-connector building is client-side and does not make this axis applicable.
